title: MPC plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: Describes one plugin for the Akai MPC standalone host. This file is copied verbatim into the deployable '<manufacturer> - VST - <name>' folder. The MPC matches it against the strings the binary reports, so name, manufacturer and uid must equal PluginInfo.name, PluginInfo.vendor and PluginInfo.uniqueId in the C++ source.

name.description: Plugin name shown on the MPC. Must equal PluginInfo.name (effGetEffectName). Used in the output folder name '<manufacturer> - VST - <name>'.

manufacturer.description: Vendor name. Must equal PluginInfo.vendor (effGetVendorString). Used in the output folder name.

version.description: Plugin version such as "1.0.0". build.py pads it to four components in version.xml (1.0.0.0) and uses it in the zip name.

format.description: Plugin format. Currently always "vst2"; reserved so other plugin formats can be added later.

kind.description: "instrument" (receives MIDI, usually 0 audio inputs) or "effect" (audio in/out, never receives MIDI). Must agree with PluginInfo.isInstrument.

uid.description: Unique four-character code, e.g. "AcWb". Must equal PluginInfo.uniqueId = MPC_FOURCC('A','c','W','b') (first character is the most significant byte). An integer or "0x" hex string is also accepted.

numInputs.description: Audio input channels (effects: usually 2; instruments: usually 0). Must equal PluginInfo.numInputs.

numOutputs.description: Audio output channels. Must be > 0 or the MPC will not list the plugin. Multi-output instruments (e.g. 8) are routable as stereo pairs. Must equal PluginInfo.numOutputs.

category.description: Optional category label such as "Synth" or "Effect".

file32.description: Path, relative to the plugin folder, of the 32-bit ARM (armhf) shared object: "VST/<slug>-arm32.so".

file64.description: Path, relative to the plugin folder, of the 64-bit ARM (AArch64) shared object: "VST/<slug>-arm64.so".

description.description: Optional one-line description used for packaging and the README; ignored by the MPC.

author.description: Optional author name for packaging; ignored by the MPC.

url.description: Optional project URL for packaging; ignored by the MPC.

license.description: Optional license identifier for packaging; ignored by the MPC.
